CustomObject.description: The pair ledger. Two rows per pair: the unowned row call 1 located, and the row call 2 identified, linked by self-lookup. Ruled by Matthew 4 August. It is a new object rather than a Candidate because a pair is not a proposed claim: it has no subject, no person and no verdict, it is an observation about the transcript, and it must persist as the byte-verification and recall-gate record long after Candidate rows retire. Two rows because every stage must be measurable on its own: pairs located, pairs identified, identifications refused, verifications refused, each a count between two row sets. The located row's verbatim answer string, byte-located in the frozen artifact, IS the anchor; there is no separate anchor entity.
CustomObject.label: AAO Pair
